title: SocialMe
problem_statement: People want to connect with others who share their interests, but existing social media platforms have become overwhelming and filled with irrelevant content. SocialMe will create a better social experience that is more focused on meaningful connections and relevant content that users actually want to see.
target_users: Social media users who are frustrated with existing platforms
Young adults who want to connect with like-minded people online
People who want a healthier and more positive social media experience
user_stories: As a user, I want to connect with people who share my interests so that I can have meaningful conversations
As a user, I want to see content that is relevant to my interests so that I don't waste time on irrelevant posts
As a user, I want to share my thoughts and experiences so that I can express myself to my network
As a user, I want privacy controls so that I can decide who sees my content and profile
acceptance_criteria: Users should be able to create a profile and connect with other users
The content feed should show posts that are relevant to user interests
Users should be able to post text, photos, and videos to the platform
Privacy settings should be available and reasonably easy to configure

success_metrics.target: Large and growing user base in year one
High daily engagement from registered users

success_metrics.metric: User satisfaction with SocialMe vs other platforms
success_metrics.target: Users prefer SocialMe over existing social platforms

risks_open_questions: Very competitive market dominated by Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and others
Content moderation at any meaningful scale is a significant operational challenge
Building a network effect from zero users is extremely difficult
out_of_scope: Advertising and monetization platform in the first version
Additional features to be determined based on user feedback after launch
